'''Feio Lie''' or the '''Republic of Feio Lie''' is a Federal parliamentary republic located in [[North Acrola]]. Covering a total area of 229,074 square kilometres (approximately 88,446 square miles), the nation [[List of countries and dependencies by area|ranks 104th globally]] in area. Feio Lie borders [[Areoix Lie]] to the north, [[Acetoa]] and [[Saa]] to the east, [[Umendel]] to the south, and [[Terressin]] to the west. Its capital and largest urban centre is [[Keliaro]], which serves as the primary hub for the country’s political, cultural, and economic activities. As of 1765 AFA, Feio Lie has an estimated population of approximately [[List of countries and dependencies by population|7.89 million people]], predominantly identifying as Feian and speaking the official [[Arten language]].

The recorded history of the region begins with the [[Arten settlement of Acetoa|Arten settlement]] in 1440 AFA, which established the foundational social and linguistic structures of the territory. For several centuries, the region maintained a consistent territorial footprint with minimal border shifts. In 1635 AFA, the territory was reorganised as a [[Sialq protectorate]] under the jurisdiction of [[Areoix Lie]]. This period of closer administrative oversight lasted until the early 18th century. Feio Lie achieved formal sovereignty in 1715 AFA following the [[Arten Revolution]] and the [[Declaration of Rights]] within [[Areoix Lie]]. [[Post-independence]] history has been defined by internal stability and a declining economy, though the state has navigated specific periods of civil strife.

The political system of Feio Lie is structured as a [[wikipedia:Parliamentary_republic|federal parliamentary republic]]. Legislative authority is held by the [[Appic Alsa]], a bicameral legislature comprising the [[Dumentemov]] (upper house) and the [[Dumentemli]] (lower house). The executive branch is headed by the [[Catesi]] and the [[Sallam]]. While the nation transitioned from colonial status to independence, it retains a close diplomatic and functional relationship with its former sovereign, [[Areoix Lie.]] The legal system and administrative protocols are largely derived from the 4th century BFA.

The Feian economy is defined by a nominal GDP of {{Lahn}}54 billion, [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|ranking 94th globally]] in area. The nation maintains a high [[List of countries by Krali Total Development Index|Krali Total Development Index (KTDI) of 0.717]], supported by a robust social welfare framework. The [[Feian Araik (FAK)]] serves as the dual legal tender along with the [[Arten Araik|Arten Araik (AAR)]], depending on where in the nation you are. National infrastructure is largely centralised, facilitating a high degree of connectivity despite the large amount of roads that characterise the interior.
